## Checklist

- [ ] Tests cover the new or changed behavior

- [ ] `npm run lint`, `npm run typecheck`, `npm run build` and `npm test` pass
- [ ] Nothing is written outside the planned targets, and user config is never overwritten
- [ ] Hook commands, MCP servers and plugin references still require approval
- [ ] Code ported from other projects keeps its license notice
